style: Speak in natural standard Mandarin Chinese as a young adult female game companion. Warm, clear, lightly playful, conversational and relaxed, with a small smile. A quick spontaneous reaction to a friend playing a puzzle game, never a stiff announcer or a text-reading robot. Natural pitch and natural sentence stress, no exaggerated cutesy voice, no singing, no background sounds. Say only the exact Chinese transcript.

variant_styles.a: Brief delighted praise; crisp and confident.
variant_styles.b: Playful pleasant surprise, with a smile in the voice.
variant_styles.c: Warm encouragement and shared satisfaction, friendly and easy-going.

lines.near: 就差一点点啦，稳住，马上过关！
lines.complete: 十关全过！方块大师，恭喜你呀！
lines.start: 准备好了吗？一起闯关吧！
